title: PhysxDrivePerformanceEnvelopeAPI
summary: Actuator performance envelope of one joint drive (maximum actuator velocity, velocity-dependent resistance, speed-effort gradient), applied as PhysxDrivePerformanceEnvelopeAPI:<inst> alongside PhysicsDriveAPI:<inst>. Effective only on articulation joints: standalone joints strip it with a warning. Every instance except linear is treated as rotational and converted.
producer_scope: All three declared attributes of every applied instance are published at their resolved values. physxDrivePerformanceEnvelope:<inst>:maxActuatorVelocity is rewritten to FLT_MAX when unauthored for each applied instance.

columns.name: physxDrivePerformanceEnvelope:<inst>:maxActuatorVelocity

verify.notes: Degrees to radians on every instance except linear, and only below FLT_MAX; the sentinel passes through.

columns.sentinel: FLT_MAX or inf means unbounded and is never converted.
columns.notes: conversion deg_to_rad applies when the instance is not linear and the value is below FLT_MAX.

columns.name: physxDrivePerformanceEnvelope:<inst>:velocityDependentResistance
columns.absent: No slope on the maximum-effort line (constant maxForce over speed).
columns.notes: The parser multiplies by 57.29577951308232 (180/pi) on every instance except linear, converting torque*s/deg to torque*s/rad; the schema's conversion enum cannot express the product, hence conversion none.

columns.name: physxDrivePerformanceEnvelope:<inst>:speedEffortGradient
columns.absent: No back-EMF term (maximum velocity independent of effort).
columns.units: linear: length/s per force; others: deg/s per torque
columns.notes: conversion deg_to_rad applies when the instance is not linear.

interactions.rule: Read only when the matching PhysicsDriveAPI:<inst> drive exists; applying the envelope marks the drive as envelope-driven, and the runtime then builds the PxArticulationDrive with a PxPerformanceEnvelope whose maximum effort is the drive's maxForce.
On a standalone joint every applied instance is removed from the prim with a 'supported only for joints that are part of an articulation' warning and the plain drive is kept.

findings.summary: The rotational branch is instance != linear, so angular, rotX, rotY, rotZ and any unrecognised instance name receive the degrees-to-radians conversions. Unlike PhysxJointAxisAPI, whose conversions are selected explicitly per joint type, an unknown instance here is silently treated as rotational.

notes: Per-joint-type instance matrix: Fixed none; Revolute angular; Prismatic linear; Spherical none; Distance none; D6 (PhysicsJoint) rotX, rotY, rotZ only, translational D6 drives skip the envelope entirely; Gear, Rack, Custom none.
Articulation axis mapping: angular/rotX -> PxArticulationAxis::eTWIST, rotY -> eSWING1, rotZ -> eSWING2, linear -> eX.
